items.english: Only put chickens in a bed after harvest — never around young seedlings
items.draft: Sit hoenders net ná die oes in 'n bedding — nooit rondom jong saailinge nie
items.backtranslation: Put chickens in a bed right after the harvest — never around young seedlings
items.problem: "net ná die oes" reads naturally as "just/right after the harvest" (the draft itself uses "Net nadat" for "Right after" in quiz option 197), so the limit "only after harvest" is lost.
items.corrected: Sit hoenders slegs ná die oes in 'n bedding — nooit rondom jong saailinge nie
